meta.title: Family Cookbook – recipes, meal plan and shopping for the whole family
nav.label: Main navigation
hero.title: Recipes, meal plan and shopping for the whole family
hero.lead: One place for everything you cook at home. It runs for free on your own Cloudflare account, with no ads and no subscription, and your recipes stay with you.
hero.meta: Version 1.2 · Slovak and English · desktop and mobile
hero.alt: The weekly meal plan in the Family Cookbook app: days in columns, breakfast, lunch and dinner in rows
hero.mobileAlt: The shopping list on a phone in dark mode
why.title: What's for dinner tonight?
why.text: Recipes from grandma's notebook, links from the web and the shopping list on the fridge are finally in one place. Plan the week, the app works out portions for whoever is at the table, and turns the plan into a shopping list with only what you really don't have at home.
how.title: How it works
how.1.title: Add recipes
how.1.text: Write your own, or take them from the web with one click. The app reads the title, grouped ingredients, steps and photo, and you just check them.
how.2.title: Plan the week
how.2.text: Spread meals over the days, drag them around, save a favourite week as a template. When you can't decide, the app suggests what to cook today.
how.3.title: Shop by portions
how.3.text: The shopping list is worked out from the plan for whoever is at the table, sorted by store aisle, and what is in your pantry is taken off.
features.title: Everything around food at home
recipes.title: A cookbook that keeps grandma's recipes too
recipes.text: Recipes with portions, time, tags and ingredient groups (base, filling, glaze). Search by title or ingredient, accents optional. Add a recipe from the web with one click, through a browser bookmark or the Chrome extension.
recipes.point1: Grid or table, filters with counts, bulk edits
recipes.point2: Cooking mode with timers and a screen that stays on
recipes.alt: The Lasagne recipe with ingredient groups Ragù and Béchamel and step-by-step instructions
plan.title: The week at a glance
plan.text: Breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks for every day. Drag a meal to another day, copy a week or save it as a template. Announce a visit for a few days and portions adjust by themselves.
plan.alt: The weekly plan by day: breakfast, lunch and dinner with portions and a warning about an allergy or dislike
shopping.title: A shopping list that writes itself
shopping.text: Ingredients from the whole week are added up and converted between units, sorted by aisle, and what you have at home is taken off. Ticking works offline and the whole household sees it. Print it compactly in several columns.
shopping.alt: The shopping list sorted by store aisle, each item with its quantity and the recipes it comes from
pantry.title: What can I cook with what I have
pantry.text: Mark what you have at home with quantities and expiry dates. Recipes are ranked by how many ingredients you are missing.
pantry.alt: The pantry with ingredients at home, their quantities and days until they expire
table.title: Portions for whoever is there
table.text: Adults, children with smaller portions and guests. Allergies, dislikes and diets are flagged when you plan a meal.
table.alt: People at the table: two adults, two children with smaller portions and a guest with a nut allergy
homes.title: For one family and for the grandparents
homes.text: One person can belong to several households. A recipe you share can be copied by other households.
homes.alt: Recipes overview by meal type: soups, main courses, salads, desserts and breakfast
extras.label: More
data.title: Your data stays with you
data.text: The app is not a service you sign up for. You deploy it yourself on your own account and nobody else has access to it.
data.cost: a month on the Cloudflare free plan
data.invitedText: sign-in with Cloudflare Access, only people you invite
data.trackingText: no ads, no analytics, no selling data
deploy.title: Deploy it in about half an hour
deploy.text: No programming needed, just follow the guide. You need a Cloudflare account (free) and a computer with Node.js.
deploy.1.title: Download the source code
deploy.1.text: Download the repository from GitHub or copy it to your account (fork).
deploy.2.title: Set up Cloudflare
deploy.2.text: Create a free account, a D1 database and an R2 bucket for photos.
deploy.3.title: Set up sign-in
deploy.3.text: Turn on Cloudflare Access and list the e-mails of the people who may sign in.
deploy.4.title: Deploy with one command
license.title: Free for families, commercial use only with permission
license.text: The app is licensed under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0. For yourself, your family, learning or a hobby you can download, change and deploy it without asking. A business, selling it or running it as a service for others needs the author's written permission.
faq.label: Frequently asked questions
faq.cost.a: Nothing. The whole app fits into the Cloudflare free plan (Workers, the D1 database, R2 storage and Access for up to 50 users).
faq.code.q: Do I need to know how to program?
faq.code.a: No. Install Node.js and copy a few commands from the guide.
faq.data.q: Where are my recipes and photos?
faq.data.a: On your Cloudflare account. You can download them at any time as a backup or as Markdown recipes.
faq.business.q: Can I use it in a business?
faq.business.a: Only with the author's written permission. Get in touch through GitHub.
